title: 第460章 夺舍第460章 夺舍
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 飞雪岛上方的云影忽然出现了一丝波动，下一刻，一道身影便落了下来。
来人身穿一袭白袍，面容清俊，一头雪白长发，赫然正是雪无痕。
枯剑老人连忙迎了上去，单膝跪地。
两人在风雪中对视一眼，皆是从对方的眼中看到了深重的沉郁。
许久雪无痕才道：“确定灭杀干净了？”
他指的自然是那道真灵，确保这道真灵不会遁出一丝，回归其主，从而将他们的谋划戳破，否则届时必然是灭顶之灾。
他们早就清楚云祈仙的身世不一般，故而等了这么多年，然而千算万算，却没想到偏偏在这个最要命的节骨眼上，她背后的势力却找上门来了！
一旦让云祈仙逃脱，联系上海外，他们一样要死无葬身之地。
“确定灭杀干净了！”枯剑老人自信答道。
雪无痕这才点头，随即闭上眼睛，下一刻又睁开，神情冷漠。
“云祈仙不见了？”
枯剑老人咽了口唾沫，声音都在发抖：
“属下的神识也没有察觉，估计，估计是那海外之人给她的力量，让她打破了封印，出了飞雪岛去了！”
雪无痕冷着一张脸，神情在这一刻终于有几分难看起来。
“先去将云辛杰带上！”
雪无痕大袖一挥，卷起枯剑老人，两人瞬间化作流光，朝着地底溶洞急掠而去。
溶洞内，池水依然在翻滚。
当雪无痕与枯剑老人赶到时，云辛杰正静静地坐在池水边缘。他的脸色极其苍白，低垂着头，看不清他此刻的表情。
“少爷！”
枯剑老人快步走上前去，脸上露出几分焦急的神情。
“出了一点意外，你快跟我们走，去飞雪岛外，我们将那云祈仙抓回来！”
雪无痕也走上前去，声音温和。
“我的好孩子，你没事吧？为父接到枯老的传讯，立刻便赶来了。你姐姐云祈仙已经察觉了我们的计划，她现在逃掉了，这对我们极其不利！”
然而。
出乎雪无痕和枯剑老人意料的是，面对父亲的呼唤，云辛杰却犹如一尊石雕般，坐在原地纹丝不动。
空气在这一刻陷入了沉默。
片刻之后，云辛杰缓缓抬起头。
他的双眼通红，看向雪无痕的目光中，再也没有了以往那种极其盲目的崇拜与顺从，反而透着一种极其复杂的光。
云辛杰的声音有些沙哑，他极其突兀地反驳道，“我……我不想去了。我不想再修炼这邪功了。”
“少爷！你胡说八道些什么！”枯剑老人极其震惊地厉声呵斥道。
“我没胡说！”
云辛杰猛地拔高了音量，身体剧烈地颤抖着，他死死地盯着雪无痕，极其大声地喊道，“我...已经杀了那么多同门师兄弟了，我满手都是血！你们凭什么要逼我杀我的姐姐？！我受够了，我真的受够了！我要停手，放过姐姐，也放过我自己！”
云辛杰的话在空荡的溶洞内不断回响。
content_en:
;;
"Tear it apart——!"
The cloud shadow above Feixue Island suddenly fluctuated, and the next moment, a figure fell down.
The person who came was wearing a white robe, with a handsome face and long snow-white hair. It was Xue Wuhen.
Old Man Kujian rushed forward and knelt down on one knee.
The two of them looked at each other in the wind and snow, and both saw deep depression in each other's eyes.
Xuewhen said for a long time: "Are you sure the killing is complete?"
He was naturally referring to the true spirit, ensuring that this true spirit would not escape and return to its owner, thereby exposing their plan, otherwise it would be a disaster.
They had long known that Yun Qixian's life experience was unusual, so they had waited for so many years. However, against all odds, they never expected that at this most critical juncture, the forces behind her would come to their door!
Once Yun Qixian is allowed to escape and contact Shanghai Overseas, they will die without a burial place.
"I'm sure it's all done!" Old Man Kujian replied confidently.
Xue Wuhen nodded, then closed his eyes, and opened them again the next moment, with a cold expression.
"Yun Qixian is missing?"
Old Man Kujian swallowed, his voice trembling:
"My subordinate's consciousness didn't notice it either. I guess it was the power given to her by the overseas people that allowed her to break the seal and leave Feixue Island!"
Xue Wuhen had a cold face, and her expression was finally a bit ugly at this moment.
"Go and take Yun Xinjie with you first!"
Xue Wuhen waved his big sleeve, rolled up the old man with the withered sword, and the two of them instantly turned into streams of light and rushed towards the underground cave.
...
In the cave, the water is still rolling.
When Xue Wuhen and Old Man Kujian arrived, Yun Xinjie was sitting quietly on the edge of the pool. His face was extremely pale, his head was lowered, and his expression at the moment could not be seen clearly.
"Master!"
Old Man Kujian walked forward quickly, with a somewhat anxious look on his face.
"There was an accident. Come with us quickly and go outside Feixue Island. We will capture that Yun Qixian!"
Xue Wuhen also stepped forward with a gentle voice.
"My good boy, are you okay? My father received the summons from Ku Lao and rushed here immediately. Your sister Yun Qixian has already noticed our plan. She has escaped now, which is extremely detrimental to us!"
However.
To the surprise of Xue Wuhen and Old Man Kujian, Yun Xinjie sat motionless like a stone sculpture in the face of his father's call.
The air fell into silence at this moment.
After a moment, Yun Xinjie slowly raised his head.
His eyes were red, and when he looked at Xue Wuhen, there was no longer the extremely blind worship and obedience in the past, but an extremely complicated light.
"Dad..."
Yun Xinjie's voice was a little hoarse, and he retorted in an extremely abrupt manner, "I...I don't want to go. I don't want to practice this evil skill anymore."
"Master! What nonsense are you talking about!" Old Man Kujian shouted in shock.
"I'm not talking nonsense!"
Yun Xinjie suddenly raised the volume, his body trembling violently. He stared at Xue Wuhen and shouted extremely loudly, "I...have killed so many fellow disciples, my hands are covered with blood! Why do you want to force me to kill my sister?! I've had enough, I really have had enough! I want to stop, let my sister go, and let myself go!"
Yun Xinjie's words continued to echo in the empty cave.
